node.title: Re^2: Fastest way to sort a list of integers into 0,1,2,3,-3,-2,-1
node.author: Corion
node.doctext:
This thread, especially the top post, already contains the [mod://Benchmark] and the usual scaffolding so you can easily test the speed (and correctness) of your implementation. Maybe consider using that.

Also, I highly doubt that an implementation of Quicksort will beat the built-in [doc://sort] keyword at least for the short lists that we are talking about here. Even though Perl sort uses a [wikipedia://Mergesort], it will be hard for Perl code to beat the C code simply due to the amount of time spent in the Perl runloop.
